_doc: Generated-only replacement placement spec. Heading anchors were retained from the original reviewed placement file.

figures.alt: Metal ceiling electrical box and fan mounting bracket secured to framing
figures.caption: Verify that the box and framing support are appropriate for the fan before hanging it. A standard light fixture box is not automatically a fan-support detail.

figures.alt: Ceiling-mounted ventilation housing visible from attic framing
figures.caption: Access above the ceiling often reveals framing, ducts, and wiring that affect a fan location. This is a different ceiling device, but it illustrates why the cavity should be checked before cutting or fastening.

figures.alt: Residential electrical panel context with organized branch circuits
figures.caption: Confirm the circuit, switch, and electrical condition before final assembly. When the scope reaches panel work or uncertain wiring, use a qualified electrician rather than treating a fan installation as a cosmetic task.
